notes:
- NEW: an Upscaling section on each game's page
- Render scale is now adjustable - the same trick FSR and DLSS use underneath, and it works on any graphics card, AMD or NVIDIA or Intel
- Shows which upscaler each game is running: FSR, DLSS, XeSS or TSR
- FSR and DLSS mode pickers are shown but left locked, because games do not document how they number those options and a wrong value could stop a game rendering - pick those in the game's own menu
- Rocket League gains render scale, image smoothing and dynamic resolution controls
